start: HQ, a gym on its 3-month free trial

steps.action: Extend the trial to 5 months after its start, with a reason (hq_set_trial)
user_sees: The gym row now shows the new trialEndsAt and trialCapAt
must_not: The trial set past 6 months from its start
No reason kept

steps.action: Set the plan: Pro, yearly, paid until a date, with a reason (hq_set_plan)
user_sees: plan 'pro', billing 'yearly', paidUntil on the gym row
must_not: Any money moved
The plan set without an audit row

start: HQ, a gym that pays once for ever

steps.action: Set plan 'starter', billing 'lifetime', with a date typed
user_sees: paidUntil empty (lifetime = for ever)
must_not: The typed date kept for a lifetime plan

steps.action: Set no plan (plan, billing and date all empty)
user_sees: The gym is back to 'no plan picked'
must_not: A billing left with no plan

steps.action: Extend the trial to 7 months after its start
user_sees: TRIAL_CAP
must_not: The trial changed

steps.action: Set a trial end in the past
user_sees: TRIAL_PAST
must_not: The trial ended early by mistake

steps.action: Set plan 'gold', or 'monthly' with no date, or a date 4 years ahead, or no reason
user_sees: INVALID, NEED_DATE, BAD_DATE, NEED_REASON
must_not: A half-saved plan

start: HQ, a trial that has ended

steps.action: Look at the gym after its trial end
user_sees: trialEndsAt in the past; the gym status unchanged
must_not: The gym locked or paused because the trial ended

steps.action: Extend the trial again within the cap
user_sees: New end saved; 'set_trial' audit row with from and to
must_not: The old end lost from the audit

steps.action: Change trial or plan
user_sees: The owner sees the change in 'ForgeAI access' (set_trial, set_plan) with the reason
must_not: A change the owner cannot see
Any other gym's plan shown

start: Admin app, a gym on its free trial

steps.action: Open the admin app (owner_hq_access answers 'trial')
user_sees: Trial start and end, plan, billing and paid-until
When ended: 'Your free trial ended on ...'
must_not: A wrong end date
Another gym's trial

start: The admin app tries to change its own trial or plan

steps.action: Update the gyms row directly
user_sees: Refused: HQ_ONLY
must_not: The trial made longer by the gym itself

steps.action: Front desk calls owner_hq_access
user_sees: OWNER_ONLY
must_not: The desk seeing the gym's plan and the support-access list

start: Trial ends, then HQ extends it

steps.action: Open after the trial end
user_sees: 'Your free trial ended on ...'; every screen still works
must_not: Members or records locked

steps.action: Open after HQ extended it
user_sees: New end date; a 'set_trial' line with HQ's reason
must_not: The old end still shown

steps.action: Look at the actions list
user_sees: Every trial and plan change HQ made in the last 2 years, with the reason
must_not: A plan change hidden from the owner
HQ's person's name or email shown where the code gives only action and reason
